title: refactor(ci): simplify lint/test/release workflows and improve cache parallelism
author: Avery Chen
description:
Context: Over the last two quarters we've accumulated a number of divergent GitHub Actions workflows for lint, unit/integration tests, and release automation. This has increased maintenance overhead, caused duplicated caching logic, and occasionally caused parallelism contention in our self-hosted runners.

Summary: This PR consolidates and simplifies CI workflows across the monorepo: 1) splits lint/test/release into clear reusable workflow templates, 2) centralizes cache keys and improves cache parallelism heuristics for Node/Python jobs, 3) normalizes build matrices and eliminates a number of duplicated job definitions in sub-repos, and 4) updates several dev-dependencies and GH Actions to latest stable versions for security/hygiene.

What changed (high level): consolidated .github/workflows/*, introduced .github/workflows/templates/ for reusable jobs, added cache key helpers, tuned job concurrency and matrix sizes, bumped actions/cache, actions/checkout, node-setup actions, and updated ESLint and pytest-runner dev-deps. Also added brief migration notes for repo owners.

Why: reduce long-term maintenance costs, fix intermittent cache invalidation and parallelism stalls on high-concurrency CI runs, and prepare for upcoming node20 migration across SDKs.

Testing: validated on feature branch using full pipeline; ran lint/test suites across redwood, redwood-sdk-python, redwood-sdk-typescript, and examples. Observed ~15% median CI duration improvement for lint/test jobs and reduced cache miss rate on subsequent runs.

Rollback plan: revert workflow changes via hotfix branch (revert commit) if release automation failures occur. Release automation has an opt-in flag for repositories until we complete one full release cycle.

Notes: this PR intentionally avoids large refactors of the release scripts themselves; follow-ups will focus on canary releases and parallel artifact uploads.
commit_summaries: feat(ci): add reusable workflow templates for lint/test/release
chore(ci): centralize cache key generation and improve parallelism heuristics
chore(deps): bump actions/cache and actions/checkout to latest stable
chore(deps): update eslint and pytest-runner dev-dependencies
docs: add migration notes for repo owners
review_conversation: Samir Patel: Overall looks good. A couple questions on cache key collisions when matrix contains NODE_VERSION + PKG_MANAGER. Can we scope the key with repo path?
Avery Chen: Good catch - moved to include repo path + hash of package lock file. Updated helpers and added unit tests for key generation.
Leila Morgan: Noticed one job still uses the old step for setting up Node 18; can we switch to node-setup action to support node20 in the matrix?
Avery Chen: Switched to actions/setup-node for all Node jobs and added conditional for node20 until SDKs are fully migrated.
Diego Alvarez: CI flake on integration-test job (network timeout) - added retry wrapper and increased timeout. Re-run succeeded.
Samir Patel: Approved after small nits fixed (variable naming and explicit checkout depth).
release_notes: Consolidate CI workflows into reusable templates; improved cache keys and parallelism heuristics; bumped GH Actions and dev-dependencies for CI hygiene. No behavioral changes to runtime code.
